context: area: src/components/Overview (new Encyclopedia top-level section, currently ComingSoonPlaceholder in FileLoader.tsx/tabs.ts, added 2026-09-20)
area: game/in_game/common (~124 reference category folders, 1827 definition .txt files, base game + dlc/*)
area: game/main_menu/localization/english (localization ymls, keys not filename-scoped to category)
area: game/main_menu/gfx/interface/icons/<category>/ (per-category icon assets, keyed by entry internal key)
constraint: constitution v1.2.0 Encyclopedia-data exception - structured data (keys/names/descriptions/values) may be shipped, art/icons stay local-install-only, base game and DLC alike
constraint: no fabricated display names for keys with no localization, raw key fallback (Constitution Principle IV)
precedent: src/components/Overview/rgoGameColors.ts - existing committed table resolved from game files the same way, regenerate via script not by hand

decision: encyclopedia scraper/generator lives under tools/ (e.g. tools/encyclopedia-scraping), matching existing tools/schema-mapping and tools/map-generation convention - offline generation tooling, not shipped runtime code
intent: Scrape the game's own definition/localization files (base game + owned DLC) into a structured, browsable reference Encyclopedia shipped with the app - names/descriptions/mechanics data only, never raw art

decisions.decision: Reuse existing jomini dependency to parse game definition .txt files
decisions.why: Same Clausewitz script grammar as saves, jomini already proven at scale in this project
decisions.rejected: hand-rolled parser or a second parsing library

decisions.decision: Dedicated regex-based localization merge across all english .yml files into one global key->text map
decisions.why: Paradox loc format isn't strict YAML and keys aren't filename-scoped to category
decisions.rejected: generic YAML library, or per-category filename matching

decisions.decision: Committed category-to-domain-group table (tools/encyclopedia-scraping/categories.ts) as source of truth, not runtime inference
decisions.why: FR-007 requires every category accounted for, reviewable and never silently dropped
decisions.rejected: heuristic inference from category folder names

decisions.decision: Static per-category JSON under public/encyclopedia/, fetched on demand, plus an eager small search index
decisions.why: Encyclopedia data is save-independent (unlike src/storage's per-save DuckDB schema), mirrors existing public/map/*.topojson precedent
decisions.rejected: bolting onto per-save DuckDB schema; one giant JSON/TS file for all categories; a dedicated static DuckDB/SQLite bundle

decisions.decision: v1 ships zero icons; FR-011's local-resolution path deferred to a future feature
decisions.why: no user story requires icons to deliver value; File System Access API local-grant flow is real added scope

decisions.decision: DLC detected by scanning <install>/dlc/*, every entry tagged with its source (base or named DLC), D000_shared treated like any other DLC folder
decisions.why: directly satisfies FR-010, avoids guessing at Paradox's packaging intent

decisions.decision: Cross-references resolved once at generation time and stored pre-resolved on each entry
decisions.why: centralizes broken/missing-reference handling, keeps per-category JSON self-describing
decisions.rejected: resolving links at render time in the UI

decisions.decision: Generation tool lives under tools/encyclopedia-scraping/, mirroring tools/map-generation's --install CLI convention
decisions.why: user directive + existing project precedent for offline generation tooling
decisions.rejected: a src/ build script or a server-side generation step

decisions.decision: Zero-owner per-file conventions: EncyclopediaSection composes all sub-components, navigateToEntry is the single shared jump target for both search and cross-ref clicks
decisions.why: avoids duplicating navigation logic between the two entry points spec User Story 3 requires
decisions.rejected: separate ad-hoc navigation handlers per entry point

decisions.decision: Top-level-only cross-reference links in EncyclopediaEntryView (simplified, documented in code)
decisions.why: a nested field's whole value already renders as one JSON blob; deep-linking inside it is real added complexity no user story requires
decisions.rejected: resolving/rendering links at arbitrary nesting depth

decisions.decision: game_concepts entries resolve localization via a game_concept_<key> prefix, found and fixed during implementation
decisions.why: the real game files use this prefix; without it only 90/696 entries had real names, confirmed empirically and fixed to 696/696

decisions.decision: warnOnUnlistedCategories added as a real disk-scan check, not just documented intent
decisions.why: generate.ts's main loop only iterates the assignment table and could never by itself notice a new game-added category folder; without this check FR-007's completeness guarantee would silently erode after a future game update
decisions.rejected: relying on the research.md decision alone without an enforcing check

specify.summary: All 30 tasks complete across 3 user stories; 242/242 tests pass (1 pre-existing unrelated flaky test confirmed by isolated rerun); tsc -b + vite build clean; verified live in browser end-to-end including a real bug found and fixed (game_concepts localization prefix, 90->696/696 names)
specify.key_finding: The existing jomini save-parser dependency directly handles the game's definition-file grammar too (same Clausewitz script family), so no new parsing library is needed despite the ~124-category scope.

tasks.summary: 30 tasks across Setup, Foundational (generation pipeline), 3 user-story phases (Economy & Production, full catalog, cross-ref/search), and Polish

approach: Offline tools/encyclopedia-scraping/ generator reuses jomini to scrape base game + owned DLC common/ definitions and localization into static public/encyclopedia/ JSON (per-category files + eager search index), consumed by a new save-independent Encyclopedia UI section with five domain groups, resolved cross-references, and global search. No icons shipped in v1; no changes to the per-save DuckDB pipeline.
